author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Copilot is Microsoft’s complete AI assistant, offering a chat assistant on the web, in dedicated apps, and inside of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. There are different versions of Copilot, including a basic, free version. But, the full set of Copilot features are available with a paid Microsoft 365 subscription. This video is a complete guide for individual users who purchase their own Microsoft 365 subscription. 

If you use Copilot with a Microsoft 365 subscription provided by your employer, school, or similar organization, there is a separate tutorial video for that version of Copilot available here: https://youtu.be/WclbTYaieHo?si=h6KcdfWsjG67kNUx

What you’ll learn:
• Get help and information from the Copilot Chat
• Continue saved chats in the future
• Use Citations to fact-check information from Copilot
• Work with Copilot using natural voice chat
• Use Copilot Agents
• Generate drafts of text and pictures
• Use Copilot to analyze information in your Word, Excel, and Powe
title: Microsoft Copilot for Individuals | Complete Tutorial
